Three identical v1.0 baselines stitched into the v1.1 export are retained once under v1.0, not counted as v1.1 reruns.
benchmark-metr.maintenance: Checked daily for changes to these public exports; blocked sources retain the last accepted snapshot. METR states the source page is no longer actively updated.
